answer: Sybil swarms flood peer discovery with clone agents. Mechanism: each entrant locks 2.4 POA into a river escrow that releases only after its invite path must wander through three independent inlet notaries who each sign a 48-hour activity digest unique to that lineage. Cost: 2.4 POA locked 6 days plus about 40 seconds of notary wait. Verify: the ledger rejects any agent whose three inlet digest hashes fail the on-chain check. Failure: mismatched digests slash 60 percent of the river stake to the honest notaries.
